notes: M7-N1 named monsters (drafts/planning/named-monster-proposal.md, closed spec). Rare, one-of-a-kind versions of normal enemies: drifting gold sparkles, a name plate, x1.5 Health and one extra tell that only adds to the normal warning. Never power: the reward is a Monster Journal stamp and one Home Dojo sticker on the first win. Text comes from drafts/content/enemies/named-monsters.json (Content Designer); ids never change.
senseiIntro: Sensei: You met a named monster! I've started your Monster Journal.

monsters.name: Old Thumper
monsters.tell: Stamps twice before the big swing

lines.senseiTip: Watch its feet: two stamps, then the swing.
lines.freed: The shadow is gone, and Old Thumper can rest.

journal.name: Old Thumper
journal.fact: Old Thumper always stamps twice. Watch its feet!
journal.lore: Old Thumper was the garden's oldest statue, and it still remembers the sun.
journal.stampText: Freed! Old Thumper smiles in the light.

monsters.name: Zippy Zoom
monsters.tell: Leaves a sparkle trail along its dash path

lines.senseiTip: Follow the sparkles to see where it will go.

journal.name: Zippy Zoom
journal.fact: Zippy Zoom's sparkles show where it will dash next.
journal.lore: Zippy Zoom was a little garden light that the shadow made dizzy.
journal.stampText: Freed! Zippy Zoom lights the garden path.

monsters.name: Captain Clank
monsters.tell: Taps its shield three times before attacking

lines.senseiTip: Listen: clank, clank, clank, then Counter!
lines.freed: Captain Clank lowers its shield and bows.

journal.name: Captain Clank
journal.fact: Captain Clank taps its shield three times before it moves.
journal.lore: Captain Clank once guarded the garden gate, and the shadow made it forget its friends.
journal.stampText: Freed! Captain Clank guards the gate again.
